[b]Karma comes to Pelican Town.
[/b]
Have you ever gifted Haley a Prismatic Shard only to be told it's "stupid"? Have you ever accidentally handed Pierre a piece of Corn?

[b]NPCs Trash Back[/b] adds a consequence to giving bad gifts. If you hand an NPC something they [b]Dislike[/b] or [b]Hate[/b], there is a chance they will literally throw [b]Trash[/b] right back at you.

[center]﻿[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/41531/41531-1769049252-151917255.gif[/img]﻿[/center]


[b][color=#000000][size=5]How It Works
[/size][/color][/b]
[list]
[*][b]The Trigger:[/b] The mod detects when you give a gift that falls into the NPC's "Dislike" or "Hate" category.
[/list][list]
[*][b]The Reaction:[/b] Once the awkward conversation ends, the mod waits a split second... and then you hear a trash can sound effect.
[/list][list]
[*][b]The Result:[/b] A random piece of junk (Soggy Newspaper, Broken Glasses, Trash, Driftwood, etc.) is forcefully added to your inventory.
[/list][list]
[*][b]The Limit:[/b] To prevent infinite trash farming, each NPC will only retaliate [b]once per day[/b].
[/list]
[center][youtube]EdnbVvJYHAs[/youtube]﻿[/center]
[b][color=#000000][size=5]Friendship Matters
[/size][/color][/b]
Villagers are petty, but they aren't heartless. The better friends you are with someone, the more likely they are to forgive your terrible gifting skills.

[list]
[*][b]Base Chance:[/b] By default, there is a [b]50% chance[/b] a stranger will throw trash at you for a bad gift.
[/list][list]
[*][b]Friendship Scaling:[/b] Every heart of friendship reduces this chance by [b]3%[/b].
[/list][b]The Math (Default Settings):
[/b]
[list]
[*][b]0 Hearts:[/b] 50% chance of retaliation.
[/list][list]
[*][b]5 Hearts:[/b] 35% chance.
[/list][list]
[*][b]10 Hearts:[/b] 20% chance.
[/list]Note: You can configure this! If you want a hostile playthrough, you can set the Base Chance to 100% and disable friendship scaling.

[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/41531/41531-1769049422-1849322781.png[/img]﻿﻿[/center]

[b][color=#000000][size=5]Configuration (GMCM)
[/size][/color][/b]
This mod is fully customizable using [b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b].

[list]
[*][b]Enable Mod:[/b] Toggle the mod on or off without uninstalling.
[*][b]Base Trash Chance:[/b] Set how likely NPCs are to retaliate (0% to 100%).
[*][b]Enable Scaling:[/b] Decide if friendship hearts should lower the trash chance.
[*][b]Reduction Per Heart:[/b] Configure how much forgiveness each heart buys you.
[/list][b][color=#000000][size=5]Installation
[/size][/color][/b]
[list]
[*]Install the latest version of [b]SMAPI[/b].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder.
[*](Recommended) Install [b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b] to tweak the settings.
[*]Run the game and try giving Linus a Carp.
[/list][b][color=#000000][size=5]Compatibility[/size][/color][/b]

[list]
[*]Compatible with [b]Stardew Valley 1.6+[/b].
[*]Works in [b]Multiplayer[/b] (Each player experiences their own consequences).
[*]Safe to add or remove from an existing save.
[/list]
